concerns.text: The plan assumes DeepGaze II salience map generation (CPU‑only, batch = 8) and YOLOv8 + Detectron2 ROI segmentation will complete within the GitHub Actions free‑tier limits (2 CPU cores, ≤7 GB RAM, ≤6 h). DeepGaze II is a deep CNN that typically requires GPU acceleration; on CPU the inference time for 200 images is likely to exceed the 6‑hour wall‑clock budget and may also breach the 7 GB RAM ceiling, especially when combined with YOLOv8/Detectron2 processing. This makes the pipeline infeasible under the stated free‑compute constraints.
